title: UI wave 3 E1: Icons-only toolbar, zero group gap, footer page status (Editor lane)
description: Follow docs/agent-work/2026-10-28-ui-wave-3/PLAN.md section E1 exactly (Files, Interfaces, Steps, Acceptance check, Fail-first, Stop-and-ask, Default) and read its Context, Rules and Notes for the implementer first; RESEARCH.md beside it has the evidence. House rules: register paths = this task's seeded Files (already registered on claim; add more only via files add); serial slot (node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/team-serial-check-slot) via files add right before the first expensive check and keep it until done; pinned Node; quoted --outDir on PREVIEW port 1600+N; never edit docs/design-system.md (write DESIGN DOC: text in the done note); motion checks in tests/motion-uN.spec.ts; native rendering runs only with the screen unlocked, by Claude agents or the owner; never put backticks in double-quoted shell text; no installs, no commits; status CLAIMED; independent review required.

review.note: Reviewed only the E1 parts of the diff (the same files also carry E3 table-menu edits, not reviewed). Independent run: pinned tsc 0 errors; fresh vite build from the current tree (rev-t131/dist, exit 0); Playwright editor-toolbar + motion-u6 + accessibility 14/14 pass on port 1651, including the new 'icons only at every width' and 'default window keeps Insert on the bar' cases. Spec checked: LABEL_MIN_WIDTH/labels/labelsRef/data-labels removed, single groupWidths cache, format-bar gap 0, onPageStatus dep added, [data-labels] CSS gone, More keeps labelled rows. Screenshots toolbar-light/dark.png viewed: icons only, Insert image/table on the bar at 1240 px, no overflow. F1: toolbar icons now default to var(--muted) (#6c6c74 light / #a5a5af dark), over 4.5:1 on both backgrounds; F3 PASS. Suggestions, non-blocking: (1) R14 - dropdown-button hover in the format bar now changes colour to the same --text, so hover shows no visible cue (the aria-expanded fill was removed); S1 recipe may cover it. (2) The default-icon colour change to --muted is not in the done note. (3) R1 vs design-system States remains for D2. Native WebKit not run (per note).
